correctness.rationale: Restricted invariant coordinate axis of quadratic f=μ||x||²/2 yields exact nonlinear y_next=βy+x, x_next=x−I ημ y_next/max{μ|y_next|,sqrt(m)} with Bernoulli I of parameter q=ℓ/n. At equilibrium, floor-active derivative matrices A0=[[1,0],[1,β]], A1=[[1−s,−sβ],[1,β]], s=ημ/sqrt(m). Independent symbolic matrix expansion reproduced all 9 entries of the 3x3 covariance operator M(s) and polynomial identity det(I−M)=qs[2(1−β²)−(1+β−2βq)s]. Perron theorem for positive-semidefinite cone ensures covariance spectral radius is a nonnegative real eigenvalue, so any spectral radius 1 requires eigenvalue +1 (no hidden -1/complex crossing). Root at s=0 is simple with derivative -2q/(1−β)<0; other eigenvalues β,β² lie inside disk. Unique positive determinant zero s*=2(1−β²)/(1+β−2βq); high-s trace growth and no additional unit crossings show stable iff 0<s<s*. q=1 gives deterministic bound 2(1+β), q<1 is strictly lower. This is local mean-square derivative stability, NOT nonlinear global divergence; at equality rho=1. Source verifier is exact-rational polynomial evaluation, independent symbolic algebra agrees.
